name: Rin Blekwell
source:
I met Rin four years ago when I was on a student exchange program. I actually stayed there just for her. But I still had to go back. So she came to see [url=https://vndb.org/c144566]me[/url]. I thought I'd be the happiest person in the world. Will I ever be able to forgive her up for trying to kill me. She's afraid I won't forgive.
